convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'ColorBBCandles' indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. Also includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position management (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose). Custom indicator buffer logic (Value[1]>5, Value[0]<6 etc.) requires manual Python reimplementation of the ColorBBCandles indicator and its signal encoding.

derived_values.name: ColorBBCandles buffer 4 value at SignalBar
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(handle, 4, SignalBar, 2, Value) → Value[0]=current bar, Value[1]=previous bar; encoded integer: <5=bearish zone, =5=flat zone, >5=bullish zone

other_exits: Flat zone exit: when ColorBBCandles buffer4[1]==5, both long and short positions are closed (if BuyPosClose/SellPosClose enabled)
Opposite signal exit: sell signal triggers BUY_Close, buy signal triggers SELL_Close

params.description: MM=-0.1 means 0.1 lot fixed; positive values would mean deposit fraction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: if MM<0 then lot=abs(MM), else lot=deposit_fraction*MM

custom_logic_notes: The ColorBBCandles custom indicator uses buffer index 4 which returns an integer-encoded color zone value. Values >5 indicate bullish zone (candle above middle BB), values <5 indicate bearish zone (candle below middle BB), value==5 indicates flat/neutral zone. Entry logic: long when previous bar >5 (bullish) AND current bar <6 (transitioning/confirming); short when previous bar <5 (bearish) AND current bar >4 (transitioning/confirming). The EA uses LoadHistory() and CIsNewBar from TradeAlgorithms.mqh for bar synchronization. GlobalVariableDel_ is also from the external library. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous completed bar (index 1), not the current forming bar, which is proper for backtesting.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement ColorBBCandles indicator: it draws colored candles based on which BB deviation band the price resides in. Buffer 4 encodes zone as integer (likely 1-10 range with 5=middle). BB parameters: period=100, deviations=[1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0], MA method=EMA, applied to Close price. Entry logic is straightforward once indicator is replicated: long if prev_bar_zone>5 and curr_bar_zone<6; short if prev_bar_zone<5 and curr_bar_zone>4; flat close if zone==5. TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen etc.) handle standard market orders with SL/TP, so they map directly to simple order placement in Python. The MM parameter with negative=lot size convention must be handled. SignalBar=1 ensures no lookahead bias.
